evidence.observation: T701 reads 434.8 °C while the other reboiler heater T702 reads 70.0 °C and vessel T703 reads 70.4 °C; the extreme heater-temperature discrepancy persists.
The discrepancy was already present initially: T701 439.6 °C, T702 69.75 °C, T703 69.8 °C.
Distillate and reflux flows both fell to zero while T701 decreased to 381.4 °C; whether this interruption was commanded is not reported.
Distillate and reflux flows have resumed at 0.2 and 0.5, with cooling-water flow 6.4; these do not validate the anomalous heater reading.

args.missing_evidence: H701 operating limits, setpoint and power history, and an independent heater-temperature measurement are needed to distinguish actual overheating from a sensor/readout fault. Protocol phase history is needed to explain the flow interruption. Pressure instruments are not installed, and no composition measurement or separation target is supplied.
